_comment: Packaging-side licence manifest (P17 / ADR-0004, #653), the complement to license-exceptions.json. gate:licenses scans the npm/py DEPENDENCY tree; it is blind to what our IMAGES ship. This file declares the two surfaces it cannot see, and gate:image-licenses (scripts/gates.mjs) audits them: `images` = third-party container images pinned by deploy-owned compose, Helm, Lite Dockerfile FROM surfaces, or Lite Makefile `*_IMAGE` variables (an undeclared pin fails; a non-permissive one needs a logged `reason`); `bundled` = components baked INTO a published vexaai/* image (redistribution — Cat A or Cat-B-with-reason only, Cat X always fails). `name` matches an image ref with its :tag stripped. The per-release SPDX SBOM inventories every package name installed by the Lite final stage; because Docker source cannot resolve Ubuntu package versions or licences, those fields stay NOASSERTION until an image-level scanner enriches them.

images.name: openbao/openbao
images.reason: Optional credential-store backend for the Connections broker (VEXA_CONNECTIONS_STORE=openbao, ADR-0040). Not pinned on any deploy surface and not redistributed in any vexaai/* artifact: compose and the chart default to the broker's own AES-256-GCM store, and an operator who chooses OpenBao runs their own server and points the broker at it over HTTP. MPL-2.0 is Category B (file-level weak copyleft); the broker is separate code that only speaks OpenBao's KV v2 API, so no Vexa source is covered. Declared here so the day a surface pins it, the licence decision is already on record.
images.note: The 0.13.2 development harness (deploy/dogfood/credentials-mvp, removed) pinned ghcr.io/openbao/openbao by digest; that compose file was never a scanned deploy surface.

images.name: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright
images.note: Pinned base and builder image for Vexa Lite. Playwright is Apache-2.0; Ubuntu package names installed in the final stage are separately inventoried in the SPDX with unresolved fields stated as NOASSERTION.

images.name: valkey/valkey
images.note: compose + helm cache/stream store (#653). BSD-3 permissive; parity with the Lite source-build.

images.name: postgres
images.note: Primary datastore. The PostgreSQL Licence is an OSI-approved permissive (BSD/MIT-style) licence.

images.name: edoburu/pgbouncer
images.note: Connection pooler. Wrapper image is MIT; PgBouncer itself is ISC — both Category A.

images.name: versity/versitygw
images.note: Object storage for Lite and Compose (the `storage` sidecar): versitygw with its POSIX backend, recordings as plain files in a local volume. Apache-2.0 is Category A. Pinned by tag and digest in deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml and deploy/lite/Makefile (the gate scans the Lite Makefile image variables).

images.name: fedirz/faster-whisper-server
images.note: Opt-in local CPU speech-to-text sidecar for Lite (LOCAL_STT, WHISPER_IMAGE in deploy/lite/Makefile). Upstream speaches-ai/speaches (formerly fedirz/faster-whisper-server), MIT, Category A. User-pulled and not redistributed inside any vexaai/* artifact.

images.name: searxng/searxng
images.reason: Search endpoint the operator pulls DIRECTLY from SearXNG's own registry, unmodified and pinned by digest — it is not redistributed inside any vexaai/* artifact, so no AGPL source-offer obligation attaches to Vexa's Apache-2.0 images; the obligation rests with the upstream image the operator runs. OFF by default behind the `search` compose profile; it answers WebSearch for the openai-agent harness through VEXA_SEARCH_URL, which accepts any endpoint of that shape. A deliberate, reviewed sidecar allowance (ADR-0004), same disposition as minio/minio. Not a bundled component, and not a Helm chart component.

images.name: litellm/litellm
images.note: The llm-shim: the Anthropic /v1/messages front door for a deployment running its own OpenAI-dialect model server (deploy/compose/llm-shim/README.md). OFF by default, behind the `llm-shim` compose profile, and operator-pulled from LiteLLM's own registry — never redistributed inside a vexaai/* artifact. LiteLLM's LICENSE is MIT with one carve-out: content under `enterprise/` is governed by `enterprise/LICENSE`. We pin, run and vouch for the image as published; we bundle no part of it.

bundled.name: valkey
bundled.how: source-build from the pinned git tag 8.1.9 (deploy/lite/Dockerfile.lite valkey-builder stage); valkey-server + valkey-cli copied into the final image, COPYING preserved at /usr/local/share/valkey/LICENSE
bundled.reason: XAUTOCLAIM parity with compose/helm and off BOTH jammy apt's stale Redis 6.0.16 (no XAUTOCLAIM) and source-available Redis ≥7.4 (RSALv2/SSPLv1). BSD-3 is Category A — clean to redistribute (#653).
